Hotel Fire Near Tarapith Temple Kills at Least 5 Pilgrims

A fire broke out at Hotel Bideshinii near the Tarapith temple in West Bengal's Birbhum district early Monday morning. At least five pilgrims were killed and several others critically injured. The fire quickly spread, trapping guests who were asleep. Firefighters responded to the scene and extinguished the blaze. The exact cause of the fire is under investigation.
